"""Fig 1: Grid-b Sweep curve (ρ=0.4)."""
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.size': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

# Data
b_seed42 = [0.3, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0]
ppl_seed42 = [17.640, 17.651, 17.692, 17.718, 17.741, 17.774, 17.818]

b_seed123 = [0.5]
ppl_seed123 = [17.638]

b_seed456 = [0.5]
ppl_seed456 = [17.650]

uniform_ppl = 17.694
adaptive_fix_ppl = 17.653

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

ax.plot(b_seed42, ppl_seed42, 'o-', color='#1f77b4', label='seed=42', linewidth=1.8, markersize=5)
ax.plot(b_seed123, ppl_seed123, 's', color='#ff7f0e', label='seed=123', markersize=7)
ax.plot(b_seed456, ppl_seed456, '^', color='#2ca02c', label='seed=456', markersize=7)

ax.axhline(uniform_ppl, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, label=f'Uniform ({uniform_ppl:.3f})')
ax.axhline(adaptive_fix_ppl, color='#d62728', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, label=f'Adaptive-fix ({adaptive_fix_ppl:.3f})')

# Annotate RUNNING points
for b_val, x_offset in [(0.1, 0), (0.2, 0)]:
    ax.annotate('RUNNING', xy=(b_val, uniform_ppl), fontsize=8, color='gray',
                ha='center', va='bottom', style='italic',
                xytext=(b_val, uniform_ppl + 0.015),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='gray', lw=0.8))

ax.set_xlabel('Reweighting strength $b$')
ax.set_ylabel('Eval PPL (holdout)')
ax.set_xlim(-0.1, 5.5)
ax.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('artifacts/figures/grid_b_sweep.pdf')
plt.savefig('artifacts/figures/grid_b_sweep.png')
print("Saved grid_b_sweep.pdf / .png")

"""Fig 2: τ-PPL curve for ρ=0.4 and ρ=0.6."""
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.size': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

# Data ρ=0.4
tau_04 = [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95]
ppl_04 = [17.678, 17.681, 17.660, 17.653, 17.699, 17.712]
uniform_04 = 17.694
best_idx_04 = 3  # τ=0.8

# Data ρ=0.6
tau_06 = [0.6, 0.7, 0.8]
ppl_06 = [17.736, 17.730, 17.740]
uniform_06 = 17.766
best_idx_06 = 1  # τ=0.7

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

# Safe range shading [0.5, 0.8] for ρ=0.4
ax.axvspan(0.5, 0.8, alpha=0.08, color='#1f77b4', label='Safe range [0.5, 0.8]')

# ρ=0.4
ax.plot(tau_04, ppl_04, 'o-', color='#1f77b4', linewidth=1.8, markersize=5, label=r'$\rho=0.4$')
ax.plot(tau_04[best_idx_04], ppl_04[best_idx_04], '*', color='#1f77b4', markersize=14, zorder=5)
ax.axhline(uniform_04, color='#1f77b4', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.6,
           label=f'Uniform ($\\rho$=0.4): {uniform_04:.3f}')

# ρ=0.6
ax.plot(tau_06, ppl_06, 's-', color='#d62728', linewidth=1.8, markersize=5, label=r'$\rho=0.6$')
ax.plot(tau_06[best_idx_06], ppl_06[best_idx_06], '*', color='#d62728', markersize=14, zorder=5)
ax.axhline(uniform_06, color='#d62728', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.6,
           label=f'Uniform ($\\rho$=0.6): {uniform_06:.3f}')

# Annotate optimal τ
ax.annotate(r'$\tau^*=0.8$', xy=(0.8, 17.653), xytext=(0.85, 17.645),
            fontsize=9, color='#1f77b4',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#1f77b4', lw=1.0))
ax.annotate(r'$\tau^*=0.7$', xy=(0.7, 17.730), xytext=(0.75, 17.722),
            fontsize=9, color='#d62728',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#d62728', lw=1.0))

ax.set_xlabel(r'Threshold $\tau$')
ax.set_ylabel('Eval PPL (holdout)')
ax.set_xlim(0.45, 1.0)
ax.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('artifacts/figures/tau_ppl_curve.pdf')
plt.savefig('artifacts/figures/tau_ppl_curve.png')
print("Saved tau_ppl_curve.pdf / .png")

"""Fig 3: ρ=0.4 vs ρ=0.6 method comparison bar chart."""
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.size': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

methods = ['Uniform', 'Adaptive\n(dual)', 'Grid-best', 'ESS-only']
ppl_04 = [17.694, 17.653, 17.640, 17.730]
ppl_06 = [17.766, 17.730, 17.704, 17.770]

x = np.arange(len(methods))
width = 0.35

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

bars1 = ax.bar(x - width/2, ppl_04, width, label=r'$\rho=0.4$', color='#1f77b4', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
bars2 = ax.bar(x + width/2, ppl_06, width, label=r'$\rho=0.6$', color='#d62728', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)

# Value labels on bars
for bar in bars1:
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.002,
            f'{bar.get_height():.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)
for bar in bars2:
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.002,
            f'{bar.get_height():.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# Annotation for ρ=0.6 adaptive
ax.annotate(r'$\tau$=0.7 (opt.); $\tau$=0.8$\rightarrow$17.740',
            xy=(x[1] + width/2, 17.730), xytext=(x[1] + 0.6, 17.745),
            fontsize=8, color='#555555',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#555555', lw=0.8))

ax.set_ylabel('Eval PPL (holdout)')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(methods)
ax.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)

# Tighter y-axis to show differences
ax.set_ylim(17.60, 17.82)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('artifacts/figures/rho_comparison.pdf')
plt.savefig('artifacts/figures/rho_comparison.png')
print("Saved rho_comparison.pdf / .png")
